title: Online Tokenization with Optimal Delay in Linear Time
abstract: arXiv:2610.19139v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tokenization is an essential preprocessing step in almost all large language models (LLMs). One of the most popular frameworks is BPE tokenization, which consists of special token segmentation, pretokenization, and byte-pair encoding (BPE). However, existing algorithms are sequential, with each stage only processing complete output from the previous stage. In order to reduce latency and memory footprints, recent works (Jiang and Gong, ICML 2026) (Li, Yang and Mamouras, ASPLOS 2026) (Mamouras, Li and Yang, PLDI 2026) have initiated the study of online algorithms for subroutines such as pretokenization and BPE with a goal of streaming input to output as the input arrives online. However, the search for efficient online tokenization remains open.   In this work, we formalize and resolve online tokenization. translated_title: 线性时间内实现最优延迟的在线分词
translated_abstract: 分词是几乎所有大语言模型（LLM）中必不可少的预处理步骤。最流行的框架之一是BPE分词，它由特殊词元切分、预分词和字节对编码（BPE）三个部分组成。然而，现有的算法是顺序执行的，每个阶段只能处理上一阶段的完整输出。为了降低延迟和内存占用，最近的一些工作（Jiang and Gong, ICML 2026）（Li, Yang and Mamouras, ASPLOS 2026）（Mamouras, Li and Yang, PLDI 2026）已经开始研究针对预分词和BPE等子程序的在线算法，目标是在输入在线到达时以流式方式将输入转化为输出。然而，如何实现高效的在线分词仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在本工作中，我们形式化并解决了在线分词问题。我们引入了在线分词“延迟”的概念，用于刻画算法输出落后于（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文首次形式化并解决了在线分词问题，提出了延迟达到最优且运行时间为线性的在线分词算法。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes and resolves the problem of online tokenization, presenting an online algorithm that achieves optimal delay while running in linear time.
